cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Which label colour suits these boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Good labels prevent moving-day confusion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'd better choose a colour the driver likes.
